verification_methodology_note: IMPORTANT — DISTINCT, LOWER-CONFIDENCE VERIFICATION TIER: this track does NOT use this corpus's standard MOJ-portal-database-times-official-PDF double-verification pipeline (this law is not a MOJ-issued instrument and is not present on the MOJ legal portal), and does NOT use the secondary BOE-official-portal-via-Wayback byte-identical-snapshot fallback used for several other tracks (laws.boe.gov.sa and web.archive.org were both confirmed unreachable from the build environment on repeated attempts across three separate research passes: laws.boe.gov.sa fails at the TLS handshake stage with a connection reset on every path/variant tried; web.archive.org is blocked by the sandbox's network egress policy outright). Two verification tiers are used instead, and every article is explicitly tagged with which tier it received via its own status/verification_tier field: (1) SINGLE_PRIMARY_SOURCE_TOPICAL_CORROBORATION — applied to the 16 articles unchanged since the original 1412H enactment: full verbatim text was extracted from a single official source (a scanned booklet at faculty.ksu.edu.sa carrying the Bureau of Experts' own letterhead, 'هيئة الخبراء بمجلس الوزراء', King Fahd National Library catalog entry dated 1417H, ISBN 3-04-831-9960 — committed at inputs/anti_bribery_official_pdfs/anti_bribery_law_1412h_original_ksu.pdf, sha256 ecff778d4e43bedd35a72958baf03906d83e3ab8e2453434c4d162b5e662c9af) and topically corroborated (article count, decree number/date, and each article's operative-clause paraphrase) against a second, independently-hosted 2-page summary table at nawaf-law.com.sa — the table is NOT full verbatim text, so this does not meet this corpus's usual article-by-article byte/text-similarity cross-verification standard; it is a genuinely weaker tier than every other track in this corpus. (2) SECONDARY_SOURCE_CONVERGENCE_UNVERIFIED_PRIMARY — applied to the 7 amended articles (5, 8, 9, 14, 15, 17, 21) and the 2 newly-added مكرر articles: their current text was NOT confirmed against any primary official gazette scan or the MOJ/BOE portals directly; it rests entirely on convergence between two Saudi legal-publishing sites (nezams.com and manielaw-sa.com, whose consolidated-text PDF is committed at inputs/anti_bribery_official_pdfs/anti_bribery_law_consolidated_manielaw.pdf, sha256 5ae22e19932dad92761357a8a966522b81778f56961b5a4adac2705056f6ac9b) which are themselves suspected to share a common upstream consolidation source rather than being fully independent of each other, plus search-engine-surfaced corroboration (including one partial, non-full-text confirmation via a live fetch of the official Umm Al-Qura Gazette portal, uqn.gov.sa, for the M/38 1443H amendment's substance) and, for the two مكرر articles specifically, one additional independent WebSearch snippet matching verbatim. This is the WEAKEST verification tier used anywhere in this corpus and should be weighted accordingly by any downstream consumer. The repository owner explicitly reviewed and approved ingestion under this distinct, clearly-flagged tier after two dedicated research passes confirmed the primary MOJ/BOE/Umm-Al-Qura channels were not reachable from the build environment.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: One WebSearch-surfaced synthesis (unattributed/uncertain source) rendered this article with 'وزارة الداخلية' (Ministry of Interior) instead of 'رئاسة أمن الدولة' (State Security Presidency) — i.e. the pre-1440H-amendment wording. Two independently-fetched sources (the manielaw-sa.com consolidated PDF, read directly off the page images, and a direct nezams.com fetch) agree on 'رئاسة أمن الدولة', consistent with the CoM Decision 633 / Royal Decree M/127 (6/11/1440H) amendment substituting the two ministries in Articles 17 and 21. 'رئاسة أمن الدولة' was adopted as the current text on the strength of 2-source agreement, but this specific point was never confirmed against a primary gazette scan and should be verified if one becomes reachable. ADDENDUM (dedicated re-verification pass, 2026-07-18, prompted by the newly-ingested nazaha_law track's cross-reference finding at its own key nazaha_anti_bribery_crossref_articles_17_21_stale): this pass specifically re-checked whether Royal Decree M/25 (23/1/1446H, clause سابعاً — 'إحلال عبارة "هيئة الرقابة ومكافحة الفساد" محل عبارة "رئاسة أمن الدولة" أينما وردت في نظام مكافحة الرشوة') has taken visible effect in this law's actual published text, i.e. whether 'رئاسة أمن الدولة' in Articles 17 and 21 should now read 'هيئة الرقابة ومكافحة الفساد'. FINDING: NOT CONFIRMED — the substitution has not surfaced in any source checked, despite M/25 having been in force since ~7 Nov 2024 (90 days after its 9 Aug 2024 gazette publication) and this pass running over 20 months later. Sources checked: (1) laws.boe.gov.sa's live portal for this exact law (lawId 75e963c8-9ff3-4d10-88a4-a9a700f17f21) returned HTTP 503 on direct fetch this pass, but — unlike this track's prior passes — its Wayback Machine history WAS reachable this time: a CDX query returned 29 snapshots from 2019-11-22 through 2026-02-15; snapshots were pulled and diffed at 2024-09-30 (pre-M/25-enforcement), 2025-01-14, 2025-02-16, 2025-04-21, 2025-05-07, 2025-07-10, 2025-10-03, 2025-11-16, and 2026-02-15 (all post-enforcement). ALL of these post-enforcement snapshots show IDENTICAL wording in Articles 17 and 21's main HTMLContainer body: both still read 'وزارة الداخلية' (Ministry of Interior) — i.e. BOE's own live 'current text' field for these two articles has, on this evidence, never even been updated to reflect the EARLIER 1440H/2019 Royal Decree M/127 amendment (to 'رئاسة أمن الدولة'), even though BOE's own per-article 'تعديلات المادة' amendment-history popup for both articles correctly cites and quotes that exact 1440H amendment. This is read as a BOE site-side data-entry lag/bug specific to this document's main-body field, not as evidence bearing on M/25 either way — but it means BOE's own primary portal cannot, as of its most recent available snapshot (15 Feb 2026), be read as confirming the M/25 substitution either: it shows neither 'رئاسة أمن الدولة' nor 'هيئة الرقابة ومكافحة الفساد' as 'current', but a wording one amendment further behind. (2) nezams.com, freshly fetched live this pass (not reused from prior passes): Article 17's text as currently served still reads 'رئاسة أمن الدولة'. (3) ramilawyer.sa, freshly fetched live this pass (a source not previously checked by this track): the reward provision echoing Article 17 still reads 'رئاسة أمن الدولة'. (4) Most decisively: a 375-page consolidated compilation titled 'أنظمة جرائم الوظيفة العامة والأموال' published by الجمعية العلمية القضائية السعودية (qadha.org.sa, a Saudi judicial professional society), PDF-metadata creation date 2025-10-23 (self-labelled on its cover as 'نسخة محدثة بتاريخ 1447/5/1هـ') — fetched fresh this pass — contains BOTH (a) the full verbatim text of Royal Decree M/25's enacting clauses, including clause سابعاً's substitution mandate quoted in full, AND (b) its own separately-printed consolidated text of the Anti-Bribery Law itself, in which Article 17 reads '...وجيوز لرئاسة أمن الدولة صرف مكافأة أعلى من المبلغ...' and Article 21 reads '...على رئاسة أمن الدولة نشر الأحكام...' — i.e. UNCHANGED, 'رئاسة أمن الدولة', not 'هيئة الرقابة ومكافحة الفساد' — even though the SAME document's compilers had clearly already read and transcribed clause سابعاً elsewhere in that same PDF, and even though that same compilation's Article 14 text already correctly shows 'هيئة الرقابة ومكافحة الفساد' (matching this track's own already-ingested Article 14 wording). A full-text search of this compilation's rendering of the Anti-Bribery Law (Articles 1-23) found no additional occurrence of 'رئاسة أمن الدولة' or 'هيئة الرقابة ومكافحة الفساد' beyond Articles 14, 17, and 21 already known to this track, so no other articles appear affected by the 'أينما وردت' scope of clause سابعاً. CONCLUSION: per this corpus's policy of never inferring that a legal instrument's mandated change has taken visible effect in a specific document absent direct confirmation, this track's text for Articles 17 and 21 is NOT changed this pass — 'رئاسة أمن الدولة' is retained as verified-current, now corroborated by two additional fresh independent sources (nezams.com, ramilawyer.sa) plus one strong dated compilation (qadha.org.sa, Oct 2025) that demonstrably knew of M/25's clause سابعاً and still did not apply it. This discrepancy remains OPEN and should be re-checked again in a future pass, particularly if BOE's live portal becomes reachable directly (not only via Wayback) or a later-dated independent compilation surfaces showing the substitution actually applied.

Article 14's committee membership was updated to read 'هيئة الرقابة ومكافحة الفساد' (reflecting the 2024 Royal Decree M/25, 23/1/1446H rename of the national anti-corruption authority) based on the already-updated wording found in the manielaw-sa.com consolidated PDF. The specific consequential-amendment clause of Royal Decree M/25 applying this rename to Article 14 was NOT read directly — only inferred from the secondary source's already-current wording plus general awareness of the 2024 rename from search results. Separately, direct evidence (both manielaw-sa.com and nezams.com) shows Articles 17 and 21 still read 'رئاسة أمن الدولة' (a distinct state-security body, unrelated to the anti-corruption authority) — i.e. the 2024 rename was NOT found to apply to Articles 17/21, only to Article 14's committee reference.

Both sources consulted for this article's text ('كل شخص وعد أو عرض أو منح، عطية...') render a comma between 'منح' and 'عطية' that reads awkwardly and may be a transcription artifact rather than the authentic punctuation (possibly 'منح عطية' without a comma in the original gazette text) — preserved verbatim as found in both sources, not silently corrected.

**تنبيه سريان**: النسخة المُستوعبة هنا منشورة بتاريخ 1992-06-30، وقد رصد تدقيق السريان (scripts/audit_corpus_currency.py) إشعار تعديل واحداً في أرشيف جريدة أم القرى **بعد** هذا التاريخ، يحمل عنوانه اسم هذه الأداة بكل كلماته المميِّزة ونوعها ذاته (نظام): 2021-12-10 — تعديل نظام مكافحة الرشوة (https://www.uqn.gov.sa/details?p=18675). **الإشعار ليس نص التعديل**، ولذلك لا يُدَّعى هنا شيء عن مضمونه ولم يُعدَّل نص أي مادة استناداً إليه. والمطابقة على العنوان لا على المتن، وقد يَرِد اسم أداة داخل عنوانٍ موضوعُه أداة مجاورة، فالصفحة الرسمية المذكورة هي الفيصل. المُفصَح عنه هو أن نص هذا المسار **قد لا يكون محدَّثاً**. يُرفع هذا التنبيه فقط عند استيعاب النص المعدَّل من مصدر رسمي. (تاريخ الطبعة أعلاه محسوب من التاريخ الهجري المُثبَت في المصدر، لا مقروءاً من ترويسة الجريدة؛ وقد اشتُرط فارق ثلاثين يوماً على الأقل حتى لا يُنتج خطأ التحويل تنبيهاً كاذباً.)
